questions.6_fusion_vs_empirical_vs_rules: Product horizon card direction = fusion probability argmax only (fusion-only contract). Empirical histogram (horizon_prob_bars) is signal-rail context; default blend weight 0. Rules/tape stack participates in call_engine veto (ALL/PLAN), not per-hz card call.

ALL/PLAN correctly non-tradeable via call-engine veto.
